page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying processor configuration for this instance does not support advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), or hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA_NI). Additionally, virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM) and hyper-threading (HT) flags are unavailable. These hardware limitations restrict the instance from executing highly parallelized vector calculations, deep learning matrix operations, or hardware-accelerated encryption tasks efficiently.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.s2.2xlarge offers a high memory-to-CPU ratio, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-bound workloads that do not require intensive compute capabilities or specialized CPU instructions. Appropriate workloads include small-scale databases, caching layers, directory services, and lightweight enterprise applications that fit entirely within the 16.0 GB memory footprint but require minimal processing power.
